threads.thread_goal: Align on scope, success metrics, and 30-day onboarding journey map.

messages.text: Team, welcome to the official channel for the new Hybrid Onboarding Program. The primary objective is to create a standardized, effective onboarding experience for all new hires. Let's kick off by aligning on the scope and the key deliverables. I've attached the project brief for reference. @54023 @84941

Thanks for setting this up. I'm excited to get started. A key challenge will be balancing the standardized core content with the specific needs of different departments. How much flexibility are we planning to build in for role-specific training?
Hello! Looking forward to contributing.

That's a critical point, @54023. The plan is to address this by running a quick needs assessment with managers (T1) and creating optional, role-specific modules down the line. For this initial rollout, the focus is on a consistent core experience for everyone. Can we agree that our primary scope is the standardized 30-day program for all new hires?

That makes sense. A solid core is the priority. With that in mind, I've created a draft of the 30-Day Onboarding Journey Map (A1) as part of T2. It outlines all the proposed touchpoints. Feedback is welcome.
This is a great start, very clear structure. I've already scheduled the manager interviews for T1 this week to validate some of these assumptions.
I'm looking at the journey map A1. Where do the administrative tasks like contract signing and payroll setup fit in? Should we add a separate track for the HR admin steps?
Good question. I included 'Day 1 Admin & Setup' as a block, but I can break that out with more specific pre-boarding and day 1 tasks to make it clearer for the HR team.

Yes, please do. Let's add a 'Pre-boarding' section for all the admin work @84941 handles before Day 1. With that clarification, I think the journey map is solid. Any other objections to approving this version of A1?
None from me. I'll make that update now.
No objections, that will be much clearer for me. Thanks.
Excellent. We have our first two decisions locked in. To keep us moving, I'll take on T11 to define the success metrics and reporting cadence. I'll share a draft by EOD tomorrow.

threads.thread_goal: Finalize core training content and facilitator guide for live sessions.

messages.text: Hi team, I've uploaded the first draft of the Core Onboarding Training Deck (A2) for T3. It covers the company overview, values, and key HR policies. @434574, could you please review the policy and compliance sections specifically? @84941, general feedback is welcome.

Thanks, @54023. I'm reviewing it now. The structure is logical. On slide 12 (Code of Conduct), let's add a direct link to the full policy document on the intranet. Also, I'll need to do a final cross-check on the 'Working Hours' policy to ensure it reflects the latest legislative updates.
The slides look really professional. Just a small thing, on the org chart slide, is the photo for the Head of Finance the most recent one? I think there's a newer one available.
Great feedback, I'll add the link. Let me know what you find on the working hours policy. And thanks @84941, I'll check on that photo.

While you review, I'm also thinking about the live sessions. I've started the Facilitator Guide (A6) for T8. Given the constraint on manager time, I'm proposing a single 90-minute live session covering the deck content, with built-in time for Q&A. How does that sound?
A single 90-minute block is efficient. It keeps things simple for scheduling. Let's confirm that as the standard duration for the main live session. That works.
Will we record the session for people who can't make it?
Yes, absolutely. The recording will be available within 24 hours. I'll note that in the guide A6.
Quick update: the working hours policy in the deck is correct. No changes needed. @54023, once you add the link and update the photo, I'm happy to sign off on the content.
Perfect. I've just made those changes. The link to A2 is the same. We can consider the content final.
Great. Confirming we have sign-off on the core deck A2 (D3) and the 90-minute live session format (D4). Excellent progress.

threads.thread_goal: Agree on manager toolkit, HR admin checklist, and tracking process.

messages.text: Hi all, I've created a draft of the Manager Onboarding Toolkit (A3) to support T4. It includes a checklist, talking points, and a 30-day plan template. @54023, could you review it for consistency with the training materials? @84941, please take a look and let's align on how this connects to your admin checklist (A4) and the overall tracking process (T7).

This looks very helpful for managers. The structure is clear and the prompts are actionable. My only suggestion for A3 would be to add a small section on 'How to be a great buddy' or link to a separate resource, as that's a common question.
Thanks, I'm working on my checklist A4 for T5 now. For the tracking sheet (A5), who will be responsible for marking tasks as complete? Will managers update it, or will I?
Good thinking, @54023. I'll add a section on the buddy role. Thanks.

@84941 that's the key decision for T7. To minimize the burden on managers, my proposal is that you own the master Onboarding Completion Tracking Sheet (A5). You would update it based on attendance from live sessions and completion reports from the e-learning system. Does that process work for you?
I can own the sheet A5. I'm not sure where to get the e-learning reports, though. Can someone show me?
I can walk you through the LMS reporting dashboard, @84941. It's quite simple. We can set up a recurring report that gets emailed to you.
Oh, that would be great! Thank you.

Perfect, thanks for offering that support @54023. So, let's formalize this. Decision: The HR Assistant will be the owner for updating the tracking sheet (A5). And with the addition of the buddy section, are we good to approve the Manager Toolkit (A3)?
Yes, approved from my side.
Excellent. That's D5 and D6 confirmed. I'll finalize A3 today. @84941, please aim to have the final HR Admin Checklist (A4) and the template for A5 ready by tomorrow.

threads.thread_goal: Lock in communication plan, FAQ, and rollout timeline for pilot.

messages.text: Team, we're in the final stretch before the pilot. I've drafted the Onboarding Communication and FAQ Pack (A8) which covers T9 and T10. It includes announcement templates for managers and new hires. Please review and provide feedback.

The messaging is clear and positive. For the FAQ in A8, I suggest we proactively add a question about what to do if a new hire misses a live session. We can point them to the recording and who to contact with questions.
I have a list of common questions that new hires used to ask me all the time. I can share it to help build out the FAQ for T10.
Great point, @54023. I'll add that in. And that would be very helpful, @84941, please send that list over. With those additions, are there any other concerns about the comms pack A8?
None from me. It looks ready to go.

Okay, let's lock that in then. The communication plan and FAQ pack (A8) is approved (D7). Now, for the pilot itself (T12). The next hiring cohort of 6 new joiners starts next Monday. I propose we use them as our pilot group. We will deploy the feedback surveys (A7) on Day 7 and Day 30 as planned in T6. Thoughts?
Next Monday works for me. I'll need the final list of new hires to start the admin process. Will the survey links in A7 be sent out automatically?
I'll get you the list by EOD. The survey links will be embedded in the calendar invites and journey map, so new hires can access them directly. We won't need to send separate emails.
The timeline and plan for the pilot sound good. I'm ready to facilitate the live session next week.

Fantastic. Then we have our final decision. We will proceed with the pilot for the cohort starting next Monday, with the agreed evaluation checkpoints (D8). This is a huge milestone, team. Let's make sure all our artifacts are finalized and ready for launch.
